feeds.title: Teaching Mama
feeds.description: Teaching Mama is a education blog, dedicated to sharing hands-on learning activities for children, particularly toddlers and preschoolers. Angela shares sensory play ideas, ways to keep toddlers busy, preschool learning activities, pintables, and thoughts on motherhood.

feeds.title: Cool Cat Teacher Blog
feeds.description: The Cool Cat Teacher Blog helps you be an excellent educator every day with advice, ideas, and inspiration. Authored by Vicki Davis, a full-time teacher. Vicki has years of experience teaching teachers how to use technology in the classroom.

feeds.title: Techie Homeschool Mom Blog
feeds.description: I love finding and creating new resources to supplement our learning, and I want to help you find the resources that will best encourage your children in their learning, too. Welcome to Techie Homeschool Mom. Whether you're tech clueless, curious, or competent, I hope you'll leave here inspired and equipped to incorporate digital learning experiences into your homeschool.

feeds.title: Pernille Ripp
feeds.description: Pernille Ripp is an expert in literacy and technology integration and dedicates her research and practice to developing engaged and empowered students and communities.

feeds.title: Moffatt Girls
feeds.description: Fun and effective educational math and literacy resources to help students and teachers of preschool. Annie Moffatt is a stay-at-home mom, wife, and former elementary school teacher.

feeds.title: Tales from a Very Busy Teacher
feeds.description: I earned my BA from the University of California Irvine, my Multiple Subjects Teaching Credential from CalState Bakersfield, and my Masters in Educational Leadership and Policy studies from CalState Northridge.I am currently teaching 3rd grade in Southern California.

feeds.title: Tech Savvy Mama
feeds.description: I'm the founder of the award-winning tech-savvy mama, a site that since 2008, has been helping parents navigate parenting in the digital age. I've combined my knowledge of child development, psychology, education, tech and parenting to provide useful advice for families about digital parenting topics since 2008.

feeds.title: Spanish Mama Blog
feeds.description: Resources for Teaching Language & Spanglish Living. Spanish Mama offers ideas and help for the language classroom and Spanglish families. I'm Elisabeth, the teacher and mother behind Spanish Mama. I actually never expected to speak Spanish, teach Spanish, or raise my kids in it. I created this little corner of the internet because life surprised me. I did learn a second language, and later, I discovered resources that gave me confidence as a teacher and parent.

feeds.title: Toronto Teacher Mom
feeds.description: Diana is a mother of two children and works as an elementary French teacher in Toronto, Ontario. She launched her blog in 2006, sharing her thoughts as a mother, a teacher, and everything in between. I also feature articles on technology, education, local events, resources for teachers, and more.

feeds.title: More Time 2 Teach Blog
feeds.description: My name is Melissa Yglesias and I teach 3rd grade in sunny Florida, where I've lived pretty much my entire life. I'm that teacher that's willing to do whatever's necessary as long as it means that my students are learning! Let's uncover what's overwhelming you, find solutions, and get you excited about teaching.

feeds.title: B like Bianca
feeds.description: For the past 6 years, I have been a middle school special education and language arts teacher in the Pacific Northwest. I am the mother to a handsome 11-year-old son, with an awesome, supportive boyfriend. Over the past 10 years, I have worked in the field of education as an emergency substitute teacher, G.E.D. Instructor, mentor, tutor, and coach. I decided to start a blog based on my desire to write.

feeds.title: Nerdy Teacher Mom
feeds.description: I am a nerd, mom and school teacher. Here are some of my teachable moments from both home and school. If you like what you read, please subscribe.

feeds.title: The Homeschool Advantage Podcast
feeds.description: Welcome to the Homeschool advantage, an interview based podcast that connects homeschoolers to vendors, curriculum content creators, coops and more. My name is Bex Buzzie and I am a teacher, coach and educational course content creator from San Diego California. The homeschool advantage is here to give you the leg up in a world that is slightly upside down by connecting parents who want to homeschool, parent who have been homeschooling, teachers who are looking for an edge or new material to some of the top academy's, micro-schools, co-ops and vendors, subscribe to the Homeschool Advantage.

feeds.title: Teacher Mommy-Mommy Teacher Blog
feeds.description: While teaching, I, Jacqueline Jobes, worked with children who did not have the prerequisite skills needed to be successful in kindergarten, first grade, etc. As a result, the children struggled. That's when I made it up in my mind that I would provide educational services to those in need. I decided to share my gifts and talents to help other children obtain a quality education. Teacher Mommy-Mommy Teacher provides parents, caregivers, and teachers with material to enrich student learning.

feeds.title: Simply Creative Teaching Blog
feeds.description: Find inspiration & teaching strategies for your classroom. This is a place for K-3 teachers to get advice, share teaching tips, learn about resources, and collaborate on ideas. I enjoy spending my days learning and sharing best practice classroom instruction with other teachers. I get so excited creating simple, creative resources to help teachers and students in primary classrooms. I'm Katie! I've spent most of my teaching career in 1st and 2nd grade, and I absolutely love it.

feeds.title: Physics.Teacher.Momma.
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Marianna Ruggerio. I've taught physics since 2009. I'm incredibly passionate about increasing diversity and equity in physics, as well as mentorship of preservice and novice teachers. Here you will find me sharing my classroom ideas, reflections and making Physics Education Research tangible for fellow high school teachers.

feeds.title: The Teacher Bag Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest blogposts from The Teacher Bag. You will find teacher tips and tricks, read-aloud favorites, curriculum ideas and so much more. The Teacher Bag is a place to share strategies and teaching ideas for kindergarten and 1st-grade learners. My name is Renee Dooly. I am a wife, boy mom, and teacher just navigating life.

feeds.title: Mommy
feeds.description: This blog is about all things mommy, crafting, and teaching. So this blog is for all busy women who are happily struggling to keep it together. As the name suggests, I am a mom to a one-year-old boy, a fur mom to my Havanese, a crafter, and a teacher.

feeds.title: TeacherMomPlus3 Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ayan and I am a mom of 4 wonderful, active, sweet as can be boys. My family has been homeschooling since my eldest turned 5. I am a Early Childhood Educator turned mom turned homeschooler. My reason for starting this blog was to keep a record (memory) for my boys. Life can get busy, and hectic so I wanted some where to record all the beautiful memories we would make on this journey.

feeds.title: Science Teacher Mom LLC. Blog
feeds.description: Curating At home Science Packs for children 3-10 years old and Developing curriculum for science teachers and homeschooling parents. My name is Medinah, and I'm a scientist, educator, content creator, wife to my superman and mom of 2 fun-loving boys. I'm passionate about sharing my love for science through creating content that is fun, hands-on and adaptable to children of all ages.

feeds.title: The Teacher Mom Alcohol Lie Blog
feeds.description: I am a mother of two children. One grown and one who is in middle school. I do not have a good relationship with alcohol and it goes back about 10 years. It is rooted in the lie that teachers and moms need alcohol to cope and that is okay. It is not okay and more supports should be in place. I am learning to ask for those supports. As of 9/20 - I am 40 days alcohol free. I have not used a program or AA. This blog is part of my healing as I recount my journey through writing.

feeds.title: Maestra Teacher
feeds.description: I am a 7th and 8th grade ELL teacher in my 27th year of teaching. I'm also the mother of three kids, a wife, sister, and daughter to amazing parents. This blog is a way for me to connect with other teachers and reflect on teaching, teachers, and public school education - and sometimes, parenting.

feeds.title: Teacher Mom Life Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find my ramblings of motherhood, teaching, & life while like many I try to balance it all. My name is Alissa. I have been teaching since 2008, and a mom since 2016.
